# THE HOSPITEL by Dr. — muslim-friendly STAY TOKYO

> A Muslim-friendly private villa hotel in Sumida, Tokyo, near Tokyo Skytree and Asakusa. Whole-house rental for one group per night: two prayer rooms with a Qibla indicator, halal-only kitchen, wudu-ready bath, bidets, alcohol-free cleaning, and doctor-curated sleep design. Founded and supervised by a medical doctor (Dr. Yusuke Sato).

## Key facts

- Official name: muslim-friendly STAY TOKYO | THE HOSPITEL by Dr.
- Type: private whole-house villa hotel (one group per night, sleeps up to 10 guests)
- Address: 1-20-13 Higashimukojima, Sumida City, Tokyo, Japan
- Location: near Tokyo Skytree and Asakusa. 7 min walk from Hikifune Station (Keisei Oshiage Line), 10 min walk from Higashi-Mukojima Station (Tobu Skytree Line). About 50 min by train from Haneda Airport, 60 min from Narita Airport.
- Check-in 16:00 / Check-out 10:00, contactless smart-lock self check-in
- Muslim-friendly features: two dedicated prayer rooms, Qibla direction indicator, free rental of prayer mats / Quran / hijab, halal-only tableware and cookware (no pork and no alcohol anywhere in the house), bathroom designed for wudu, bidets on both toilets, alcohol-free cleaning, curated guide to nearby halal restaurants and mosques
- Nearby for Muslim guests: Asakusa Mosque about 10 min by train; Tokyo Camii (Japan's largest mosque) about 35 min
- Sleep design: doctor-curated (premium mattress, warm lighting, herbal bath and tea)
- House rules: entirely non-smoking, no pets, no alcohol or pork brought in
- Booking: direct with PayPal or credit card at https://thehospitel.jp/book.html — also listed on Agoda and Booking.com. Long stays (28+ nights) welcome.
- Site languages: English, Japanese, Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia), Malay (Bahasa Melayu)
- Contact: info@thehospitel.jp
- Operator: Ishi no Fudosan K.K. (医師の不動産株式会社), founded by Dr. Yusuke Sato, MD
